Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I had no plans for a new grill this summer but a storm last month decided to wreck my three burner Spirit 1 that was only a few years old.

The old grill was great but it was really overkill for my family. This one is definitely smaller than the three burner models, but for the three of us it's got plenty of room. My advice is to think realistically about what you're going to be cooking and how much space you need. There's really no need to buy a huge grill if you're just going to toss a few  steaks, hamburgers,  or a package of brats on there. For the three of us this has plenty of room.

The grill was fairly easy for two people to assemble. The Mrs. located the necessary items and I put them together. Naturally the first two parts in the instruction book were at the very bottom of everything in the box, but oh well. It went together in an afternoon.

I've used the grill at least three times a week since then and everything's turned out great. 

One thing I need to mention is the location of the propane tank. In the old Spirit grills, Weber tucked it away behind a door under the grill. It's now in the open hanging off the side over the wheels. Visually this may not be as pleasing but is a thousand times easier. Getting the tank under the grill and lifting it into place to hang on the scale hook was always a chore for me. It required three hands but there was only room for one. With the new setup it's much easier to grab the tank by both sides and set it down on the hook. If you don't like your tank being visible, Weber does sell a cover with their logo for $10.

I definitely recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Just about perfect.

Hello, Thank you for being a loyal Weber fan and taking the time to share your feedback! We are sorry to hear you are experiencing issues with heating. Next time you use your grill, can you please follow these steps? 
1. Open the lid
2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position.
3. Fully disconnect your tank from the rubber hose and reconnect it.
4. Open your LP tank slowly fully open.
5. Wait 1 full minute to allow your gas to pressurize.
6. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)
7. Hit your igniter
8. Turn on all remaining burners
9. Close the lid to preheat for 15 minutes to 500-550°F.
Thanks!

Kind of a freak accident but, if that edge was finished with a roll over instead if left sharp, like it is, she would have had just a pinch and not lost any blood. That doesn't really detract from the quaility of the unit, just a minor issue that could be addressed.

Results.ReviewText: I had an older Weber "Summit" that needed replacing after about 20 years, and wanted to downsize.  We bought the Spirit II, and it's perfect.  I didn't need a lot of bells and whistles like some of the larger units offer, so this worked out great!  I love it.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have not had to install something this complicated in some time. Lots of bolts, lots of parts, hunting for parts, finding places afterwards where bolts needed to be put in, and struggling to do so, grill not lighting until the valves and hoses were tweaked, etc. You get the point. It took me several days to put it together and get it working. 

Now that the grill is assembled, debugged, and tested, it works very well. It is solid and sturdy. I like the tank level indicator a lot. 

Get this grill if you have the patience to take your time in assembly and debugging. If you do not, yo will be very disappointed.

Results.ReviewText: I used this twice and then it started leaking propane between the regulator & tank. Called to troubleshoot, customer service wouldn’t troubleshoot with me, promised to 2nd day air a new regulator and hose to me. I received it 3 weeks later. Very poor customer service from what’s supposed to be the best grill company around.  I like the grill when the propane hose system is working.
Results.Title: Defective Regulator

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill is the best I've seen, and I've owned quite a few over the years. Assembly was relatively straightforward, and there were no missing parts to contend with. The video on cellphone was helpful in interpreting what hardware goes where. A great feature is the body of the grill - cast metal, instead of sheet metal. I don't expect this one to warp. The cast iron grates are very easy to clean. The temperature controls actually work. For the first time, I can cook meat on one side and veggies on the other and know that things will come out fine and on time. So far we have done steaks, burgers, grilled shrimp on skewers, and lamb shish-kebab. All meals were fine. I am very happy with this purchase.
Results.Title: Best grill I have ever owned.

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.
